blogs.title: Beyond the Token: Why the Byte Latent Transformer is a Game Changer for LLMs
blogs.description: An introductory guide to the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT), explaining the flaws of traditional tokenization—such as sensitivity to noise and multilingual inequity—and how BLT's tokenizer-free approach allows AI to process raw bytes for more flexible and robust language understanding.

blogs.title: Stop Wasting Compute: How BLT Uses 'Entropy' to Think Smarter
blogs.description: A deep dive into the concept of dynamic patching. This post explains how BLT uses an entropy-based system to allocate more computational power to complex data and 'skim' through predictable text, leading to up to 50% better inference efficiency than traditional models.

blogs.title: Typos, Rare Languages, and Raw Bytes: Making AI More Robust
blogs.description: An exploration of the qualitative wins of the BLT architecture. This post highlights how seeing raw bytes instead of tokens allows the model to excel at character-level tasks, handle 'noisy' text (like typos or weird casing), and perform better in low-resource languages.

blogs.title: The New Scaling Law: Balancing Model Size and Patch Size
blogs.description: A technical look at the scaling breakthroughs of BLT. This post explains the 'new dimension' of scaling, where developers can simultaneously increase model size and patch size to improve performance without increasing the computational cost of running the model.
